Non-antagonists should not resist or seek revenge for a lawful arrest, but they are not required to simply surrender and let the arrest happen. In the spirit of the game, they may flee or avoid the officer without harming them.
If the arrest is clearly lawful, any response must follow the [textlink="conflict escalation policy" link="CEP"]. Resisting or taking revenge for an arrest without good reason may violate that policy and result in administrative action. If a non-antagonist player believes they have done nothing that would justify an arrest, they should use Ahelp.
When resisting arrest, non-antagonists must not rob officers or keep them detained or incapacitated longer than necessary to escape or explain themselves.
